title: Oil price climbs 3% as Iran and Israel escalate attacks
title_zh: 伊朗和以色列升级袭击，油价上涨3%
summary: Deutsche Bank says oil is rising because there are no signs of de-escalation yet in the Middle East conflict
summary_zh: 德意志银行表示油价上涨是因为中东冲突尚无缓和迹象

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks fall and oil rises as Iran and Israel launch fresh wave of attacks
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：伊朗和以色列发动新一波袭击，股市下跌，油价上涨
summary: Global markets have been thrown into turmoil this week after the US and Israel began strikes against Iran over the weekend.
summary_zh: 在美国和以色列周末开始对伊朗发动袭击后，全球市场本周陷入混乱。

title: Iran War Punctures Favored Strategy of ‘Sell America, Buy Asia’
title_zh: 伊朗战争刺破了“卖美国、买亚洲”的战略
summary: Despite a rebound Thursday, the MSCI Asia Pacific Index has tumbled about 6% this week, compared with a 0.1% slide in the S&P 500.
summary_zh: 尽管周四反弹，但 MSCI 亚太指数本周仍下跌约 6%，而标准普尔 500 指数则下跌 0.1%。

title: OpenAI tops $25 billion in annualized revenue, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 年收入突破 250 亿美元
summary: Artificial intelligence startup OpenAI topped $25 billion in annualized revenue as of the ‌end of last month, The Information reported ‌on Wednesday, citing a person familiar with the figure.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 周三援引一位知情人士的话报道，截至上月底，人工智能初创公司 OpenAI 的年化收入突破了 250 亿美元。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall after Wall Street's bounce back
title_zh: 今日股市：华尔街反弹后道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: Wall Street is in a downward pattern after days of volatility. Markets have been buffeted by developments in the conflict in Iran, now entering it's sixth day.
summary_zh: 经过几天的波动后，华尔街正处于下行模式。市场受到伊朗冲突事态发展的打击，目前已进入第六天。

title: US stocks close up on Iran diplomacy hopes; tech leads rebound
title_zh: 伊朗外交希望推动美股收盘；科技股引领反弹

title: Big Tech signs Trump's AI energy cost pledge
title_zh: 大型科技公司签署特朗普的人工智能能源成本承诺
summary: President Trump announced a new "ratepayer protection pledge," saying energy demand tied to AI data centers could more than triple by 2035, promising American households won't see higher electricity bills as a result.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统宣布了一项新的“纳税人保护承诺”，称到 2035 年，与人工智能数据中心相关的能源需求可能会增加两倍以上，并承诺美国家庭不会因此而面临更高的电费。

title: BofA reinstates Tesla coverage on robotaxi prospects
title_zh: 美国银行恢复特斯拉对机器人出租车前景的报道
summary: Bank of America analysts are all in on Tesla (TSLA), reinstating a new bullish coverage of the EV stock with a Buy rating. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian covers the latest Wall Street buzz over Tesla's expanding robotaxi services.
summary_zh: 美国银行分析师全神贯注于特斯拉 (TSLA)，恢复了对该电动汽车股票的新看涨评级，给予买入评级。雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 报道了华尔街有关特斯拉不断扩大的机器人出租车服务的最新动态。

title: Tech stocks today: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang suggests end of OpenAI investments, Apple unveils MacBook Neo
title_zh: 今日科技股：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋建议结束 OpenAI 投资，苹果推出 MacBook Neo
summary: All eyes are on Nvidia's fourth quarter results, due after the closing bell on Wednesday, as AI concerns continue to grip markets.
summary_zh: 由于人工智能担忧继续困扰市场，所有目光都集中在英伟达将于周三收盘后公布的第四季度业绩。
